snippet.title: SPINE – This is Gun Fu - Fight In Your Style Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Redline is a rebel street artist with a sentient combat implant, and she fights through a cyberpunk city run by an AI regime to rescue her brother. Nekki's cinematic gun-fu brawler launches in summer 2027.
